two_port.preflight_text:
[PREFLIGHT] pec_faces={z_lo} creates an INFINITE PEC boundary AND the geometry contains finite PEC objects. For antennas or finite-GP structures, the pec_faces boundary makes the ground plane cover the entire domain face, which changes the physics (cavity vs radiating antenna). If you need a finite ground plane, remove pec_faces and declare it: a foil is a SHEET (add_thin_conductor, or a zero-thickness PEC Box — one node plane, normal E through it live); a thick plate is a PEC Box VOLUME (walls on both faces, lattice ownership contract #931).
  [PREFLIGHT] all dielectric(s) ['ro4350b'] are perfectly lossless in an open (CPML) domain. If you are measuring Q / resonance, this gives an ARTIFICIALLY infinite Q (design-guide Anti-Pattern #1, an R5 surface-metric trap) — add loss, e.g. sigma = 2*pi*f*eps0*eps_r*tan_delta. (Harmless if you are not measuring Q.)
  [PREFLIGHT] 1 PEC volume(s) are exactly ONE cell thick along some axis and are realized as a filled slab with walls on BOTH faces (every E edge between the two faces is shorted; lattice ownership contract #931 §1.2): geometry[1] 'pec' (Box) is one cell thick along z [z: walls at 250µm and 300µm (drawn 254µm -> 304µm)]. If this is foil (a ground plane, patch or trace), declare it as a SHEET — add_thin_conductor(shape), or a zero-thickness Box via add() — which realizes on ONE node plane with the normal E edge through it live; a slab and a sheet are different conductors on this lattice. If it is a plate, an iris or a wall drawn one cell thick on purpose, no action is needed (report-only). COVERAGE: examined 1 PEC volume(s) on the uniform lane through rfx.boundaries.pec.realized_wall_planes. STALE IF: realized_wall_planes on the named entry's own edge masks returns planes more than one index apart.
  [PREFLIGHT] 2 conductor-Box design edge(s) sit off-lattice by more than 0.5% of their extent (worst 2 listed): geometry[1] 'pec' (volume) z: extent 50µm, worst face residual 4µm (8.00% of the extent); geometry[1] 'pec' (volume) y: extent 600µm, worst face residual 8µm (1.33% of the extent). OBSERVED: distance from each declared face to its nearest E-node on this run's own node coordinates; a PEC volume's face realizes on the nearest node plane and a sheet footprint on the nodes it covers (lattice ownership contract #931 §1.1/§1.3). Reported residuals describe declared-face alignment only. A sheet's extent can change by more than this nearest-node residual, and an extent change involves both faces. Read the realized bounds from fidelity_report(); frequency sensitivity depends on the mode and the affected dimension. COST (measured, #703): a uniform-mesh sweep rounded ONE substrate thickness by 8-10% across three 'convergence' points — three different boards solved under one name; the same campaign's board survived at dx=50um only because every patterned dimension happened to be an exact multiple of 50um. REMEDY: for a PEC VOLUME choose dx commensurate with its dimensions, slide the lattice origin onto the worst face, or (non-uniform lane) place mesh nodes on its faces; for a SHEET see sheet_effective_size -- a node on a sheet's edge is not the fix. COVERAGE: examined 3 axis extent(s) on 1 conductor Box declaration(s) on the uniform lane; 0 sheet normal axis/axes reported by sheet_plane_realized instead; 0 non-Box conductor entr(y/ies) skipped (no analytic face coordinates). STALE IF: |face - nearest node| on the run's node coordinates does not reproduce the printed residuals.
  [PREFLIGHT] MSL port 'msl_0' (trace W=600µm, h_sub=254µm): lateral clearance to −y absorbing boundary = 108µm (domain edge + 800µm calibrated CPML buffer) < recommended 508µm (= 2·h_sub). Fringing field will be clipped → Z0 may be biased HIGH by ~12%, mesh-conv may diverge. Increase domain y-extent OR move port further from sidewall.
  [PREFLIGHT] MSL port 'msl_0' (trace W=600µm, h_sub=254µm): lateral clearance to +y absorbing boundary = 108µm (domain edge + 800µm calibrated CPML buffer) < recommended 508µm (= 2·h_sub). Fringing field will be clipped → Z0 may be biased HIGH by ~12%, mesh-conv may diverge. Increase domain y-extent OR move port further from sidewall.
  [PREFLIGHT] MSL port 'msl_1' (trace W=600µm, h_sub=254µm): lateral clearance to −y absorbing boundary = 108µm (domain edge + 800µm calibrated CPML buffer) < recommended 508µm (= 2·h_sub). Fringing field will be clipped → Z0 may be biased HIGH by ~12%, mesh-conv may diverge. Increase domain y-extent OR move port further from sidewall.
  [PREFLIGHT] MSL port 'msl_1' (trace W=600µm, h_sub=254µm): lateral clearance to +y absorbing boundary = 108µm (domain edge + 800µm calibrated CPML buffer) < recommended 508µm (= 2·h_sub). Fringing field will be clipped → Z0 may be biased HIGH by ~12%, mesh-conv may diverge. Increase domain y-extent OR move port further from sidewall.
  [PREFLIGHT] port at (0.002, 0.0012079999999999999, 0.0) names no terminated conductor; 'pec' (entry 1) under its terminal continues into the x-lo, x-hi absorber; if this conductor is a line the port ends, pass terminates= to end it there; a ground plane should continue.
  [PREFLIGHT] port at (0.012, 0.0012079999999999999, 0.0) names no terminated conductor; 'pec' (entry 1) under its terminal continues into the x-lo, x-hi absorber; if this conductor is a line the port ends, pass terminates= to end it there; a ground plane should continue.
